snippet.title: Sails - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the Gameplay Trailer for Sails, a pirate survival multiplayer game developed by Fortune Interactive. Players will craft, plunder, and live out the pirate's life to seek riches ripe for the taking. Sails is coming soon to PC (Steam).
